name: Landing page engine showcase validates 2.5D photometric orbit, RotSprite 8x EPX, and game engine exports
description: Validates the interactive engine showcase on the home page across all four algorithm demonstration tabs: 2.5D Lighting orbit and material shine profiles, RotSprite Xenowhirl 8x continuous rotation slider maintaining crisp single-pixel contours at 45 degrees, Sobel salience downsampling, and Game Engine live JSON metadata generation for Godot 4, Unity, and Phaser 3.

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the interactive engine showcase section with id engine-showcase
Verify the engine showcase displays Tab 01 titled '2.5D Lighting & Shadows' with the interactive canvas
Click the tab button with id tab-rotsprite titled 'RotSprite Precision'
Verify the RotSprite panel is active displaying the rotation controls and comparison view
Click the '45°' preset button in the RotSprite controls
Verify the RotSprite rotation angle displays 45°
Click the tab button with id tab-export titled 'Game Engine Exports'
Verify the Game Engine Exports panel renders displaying the code viewer with SpriteFrames resource definition
